signBehavior.Aries: people move faster on identity, style, and unfinished ideas than the plan can support
signBehavior.Taurus: fixed thought loops can start to feel like facts until something simpler and steadier is chosen
signBehavior.Gemini: conversation, social input, and quick decisions can multiply faster than attention can hold
signBehavior.Cancer: care, memory, home, loyalty, and emotional safety become harder to separate from the decision
signBehavior.Leo: performance, certainty, desire, and visibility may need grounding before they become useful
signBehavior.Virgo: details, fine print, perception, and the wish to correct the problem can take over the room
signBehavior.Libra: diplomacy, preference, fairness, and relationship optics can blur what needs to be said directly
signBehavior.Scorpio: intensity, suspicion, control, and the need for honesty can make ordinary exchanges feel loaded
signBehavior.Sagittarius: meaning, restlessness, hope, and the wish to widen the story can outrun the facts
signBehavior.Capricorn: ambition, structure, fatigue, and responsibility can make rest feel like something that has to be earned

conjunction.behavior: both planetary matters gather in the same place, making the pattern harder to ignore
conjunction.constructive: Use the concentration to name the real subject instead of reacting to every signal around it

sextile.behavior: an opening is available, but it needs participation before it becomes useful
sextile.constructive: Act on the small workable option while it is still easy to reach

square.behavior: two needs rub at an angle and force a practical adjustment
square.constructive: Treat the friction as information about what has to change

trine.behavior: support is available with less resistance, which makes it easy to use or overlook
trine.constructive: Use the ease deliberately while the pattern is still easy to name

opposition.behavior: two ends of the pattern become visible by contrast
opposition.constructive: Name both sides before letting either one define the whole situation

lunation.new-moon: a beginning that needs quiet focus before it becomes visible
lunation.first-quarter: a decision point where the first real obstacle shows what the intention requires
lunation.full-moon: a culmination that makes the emotional or practical result harder to ignore
lunation.last-quarter: a sorting point where the remaining work becomes clearer
lunation.solar-eclipse: a high-volume beginning near the nodal axis that should not be forced into certainty too fast
lunation.lunar-eclipse: a high-volume release or revelation near the nodal axis that needs time before interpretation hardens

angle.Ascendant: presence, first response, body language, and how the chart approaches life become visible
angle.Midheaven: public direction, reputation, responsibility, and visible work become the surface

daylight.planetary-hour: a small timing window where the hour ruler colors the next practical choice
daylight.sunrise: the day opening through the local horizon and the first visible tone of the chart
daylight.sunset: the day handing off into evening, visibility lowering and the relational tone becoming louder

Cancer.planetSpecificFunction: Conversations, information, schedules, agreements, messages, and documents.
Cancer.phaseBehaviorClause: bringing matters involving communication and planning back for clarification
Cancer.recognizableInterruptionClause: Old discussions return; people remember agreements differently; replies and wording carry extra weight.
Cancer.returningMatterClause: A family discussion or household plan may need another pass. A repair or bill may also need checking, especially when documents, travel arrangements, or responsibilities were agreed to casually.
Cancer.practicalResponseClause: Ask direct questions and confirm details. Write down responsibilities and clarify one specific matter.
Cancer.dateClause: Supplied by the calculated retrograde event record.

sky.placement.sun.cancer.collectiveBehaviorClause: This puts more focus on what people protect, who they check on, and which places or relationships still feel like home
sky.placement.sun.cancer.recognizableSituationClause: You may notice decisions being shaped by loyalty, old memories, family pressure, or the wish to keep something familiar intact
sky.placement.sun.cancer.currentChoiceClause: Before you answer from habit, name what actually needs care and what only feels familiar

sky.aspect.sun.conjunction.mercury.headline: The Sun and Mercury are together in Cancer
sky.aspect.sun.conjunction.mercury.aspectBehaviorClause: Identity and language are moving through the same emotional weather
sky.aspect.sun.conjunction.mercury.recognizableSituationClause: People may answer from old loyalties before they realize it, or turn a feeling into the whole argument
sky.aspect.sun.conjunction.mercury.constructiveUseClause: Use this for naming what needs care and asking the direct question gently enough that it can be heard
sky.aspect.sun.conjunction.mercury.timingClause: This is most useful while the contact is active and close by orb
